'''Uthil Ren'kacal''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was part of the team led by [[Zinn Classet]], Ren'kacal assisted in the hunt for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives who had angered the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] by freeing a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], [[Kentara]]. He wore a full length blue coat, and was adorned with jewelry. A large scar on Ren'kacal's left cheek was decorated with earrings. Ren'kacal worked as the group's tracker, and was not very skilled in a fight.
